method: Five simple frontal or top-view planar symbolic diagrams; no human pose, dimensional instrument or interacting solid requires a 3D scene.
findings: Screen frames, symbolic overlays, document emblems and template holes use a single planar coordinate system.
Stencil shows an underlying sheet through holes; pencil is a separate symbol without a falsely depicted grip or contact.
Route endpoints meet the two pins; separated footprint symbols indicate walking without an anatomical pose.
